svg.title: BUDLUM LEAF · P07 VERIFICATION, RISK AND INDEX
svg.text: BUDLUM LEAF · P07 · VERIFICATION, RISK AND INDEX
Five steps from a simulation to a build, the risks that can stop it, and the index of the whole set. This sheet closes the drawing package.
A · THE FIVE STEPS · each one answers a different question

g.text: STEP 1
simulation
strain, heat, radio
STEP 2
coupon
layer by layer
STEP 3
sub-assembly
leaf, core, module
STEP 4
prototype
a working set
STEP 5
pilot
real users
1 · A MODEL IS NOT A MEASUREMENT. Step 1 proposes, steps 2 and 3 decide. A gate never closes on a simulation.
2 · the coupon proves the stack, the neutral axis, the hard coat and the adhesive in isolation, cheaply and fast.
3 · the sub-assembly proves the parts that interact: the bend band, the slide, the contacts, the antennas, the heat path.
4 · the prototype proves the system: two faces as one surface, the bend at the class radius, the core swap, the fail-safe ladder.
5 · the pilot proves the product. The latency class, the energy profile and the input rates are measured on real users, on real networks.
6 · every step captures raw data into a B.U.D. record with the instrument and its calibration date.
A CLAIM MAY NOT SKIP A STEP. A tier-2 claim needs step 2, a tier-1 claim needs step 3, and any wording that reaches the market needs step 5.
The calibration method is itself a deliverable, because a result that cannot be reproduced is not a result.
No step consumes a part that another step already measured, except for a destructive test, which is stated in the record.

svg.text: B · WHAT THE LABORATORY MUST HAVE

g.text: a two-axis bend rig with a controlled radius and a controlled speed, and a thermal chamber around it
a coupon and pull station for the stack: delamination, creep and peel, at temperature
an instrumented core rig: 1 000 slide cycles with contact resistance and temperature logged
a wired and contact charge bench: 40 W USB-C PD on the side Port Rail and 27 W on Desk Dock gold pins
an antenna range: efficiency and pattern in a free hold and in a hand hold, flat and at the class radius
a display metrology set: colour, uniformity, luminance after bending, plus a seam measurement
a battery cycler and flex rig: 10 000 bends at R 25.5 mm plus the abuse set
a link and latency set: two endpoints, an impairment emulator for delay, jitter, loss and bandwidth, and a real network capture
a small secure-element board, for the signature and the finality verification budgets
a metrology set: a micrometer on every layer, a microscope for the crease, a gauge for the seam, a scale for every configuration
one calibrated reference instrument per measured quantity, and one owner per instrument
the report format of BL1 to BL16, filled from raw data, with the same file naming rule

svg.text: A RISK WITHOUT AN OWNER IS A WISH. Every row above has a gate, a report or a question number, and every one of those has one owner.
The three highest-severity rows are the three that decide the product: the display supply, the bend of the cover, and the charge heat.
D · THE PACKAGE · the 25 sheets of this set (E01..E03, P01..P22)

g.text: BL-P01 general arrangement · 4-Quadrant (+) 80 x 160 x 2.20 mm body + 90°-Bent-Stem B module
BL-P02 stack, materials and bend · 2.20 mm 11-layer ISO 10993 PC + LLZO solid-state cell + Qi2
BL-P03 form and shape · softened prism family (Leaf 80, 160, 480), r 0.55 mm edges
BL-P04 energy, thermal and safety · 4 x 3.0 Wh = 12.0 Wh LLZO solid-state + eyewear safety (<=36.2 C)
BL-P05 link and fail-safe · the budget, the physics of distance, the radio, the fail-safe ladder
BL-P06 Budlum integration · the map, what exists, seventeen work orders, the claim set
BL-P07 verification · the five steps, the laboratory, the risk register, this index
BL-P08 energy architecture · 4-quadrant (+) solid-state battery tiles, EU 2023/1542, runtime
BL-P09 screen cost, whole-area bend and seal · <15 um n=1.585 (+) optical seam, R 25.5 mm bend, IP68
BL-P10 charge and 90°-Bent-Stem B module · universal Qi2.2 on body, ONLY USB-C in 90° B stem
Sheets E01..E03 and P11..P22 complete the 25-sheet engineering package at Revision L.5.0.

svg.text: E · CLOSED ARCHITECTURAL DECISIONS · Revision L.5.0

g.text: K1 · 80 x 160 x 2.20 mm (72 g) body split in (+) cross into 4 snap-together 40 x 80 mm tiles (Q1..Q4).
B1 · <15 um n=1.585 self-healing optical seam lip + Corning edge-wrap (zero scratch / zero line).
M1 · 90°-Bent-Stem B module (22 g): ONLY the stem is bent at 90°; round ring sits flat ON screen.
M2 · +/-90° reversible Ti hinge docks B module to Front/Back faces and all 4 edges (Top/Bottom/Left/Right).
E1 · 4 x 3.0 Wh = 12.0 Wh non-flammable LLZO solid-state battery (<=36.2 C, 0 HF, SAR 0.054 W/kg).
Q1 · Portless body charges on any Qi/Qi2.2 pad (15-25 W); the ONLY USB Type-C (40 W) is in the 90° B stem.
S1 · EU 2023/1542 Art. 11 <3 s tool-free quadrant hot-swap; 84 total modeled internal parts (94.0 g).
All 251 verification gates and 39 gap items are tracked in tools/canon.json.
